Swaying Step I

Monk · Level 6 · Drunken Discipline

Effect

Your swaying steps confuse your opponent, allowing you 100% dodge for the next 60 sec or until you dodge or activate another ability. This turns off your auto-attack.

Ranks

RankLevelCostEffect

Ten Ton Hammer class guides, 2007-2008 · every ability that changed

Available only to a Monk who has taken the Drunken Master style. It appeared in the spellbook when the style was granted at The Way Of The Sway, Part 2 (4812), and a Monk on another path will not have it. Its absence from a Monk's spellbook therefore says which style that Monk follows, not whether the emulator carries the ability.

Debuff: Shaken Staggered

Previously recorded by The Telon Project as: “A kicking attack that deals 61 to 67 damage. Icreases Jin by 2” (http://thetelonproject.wikidot.com/abilities:crescent-kick-ii)

The level recorded here was read from the VGO Emulator client. the vanguardmonks.com ability table, captured in 2008 gives a different one, and it is not an error in either: that page describes the game as it stood in 2007 and the emulator runs a much later build, so the Monk's abilities were rebalanced between the two. Forty of the Monk's abilities differ this way.

Read from the in-game tooltip in VGO Emulator. Bracketed damage figures shown in game are the skill- and level-adjusted values for that character and are not recorded here.
